start: App already set up, in no gym; member taps the gym's invite link (https://…/j/<CODE>) in WhatsApp

user_sees: Screen 'Join your gym', spinner 'Finding your gym…', then the gym's logo, name and 'Gym code <CODE>'
must_not: Another gym's name or logo; the code box instead of the gym

steps.action: Read the lines, check 'Your name' (filled from the profile)
user_sees: 'Join to see your membership and your gym's messages here…', 'Your gym sees how many workouts you log and the weight you lift, for challenges. Other members see your name only if you switch it on.'
must_not: A name box that overwrites what the member typed with the profile name

steps.action: Tick the 18+ and terms box, tap 'Join this gym'
user_sees: Busy button, then the gym's page (Shop/Gym tab) with membership and messages
must_not: Join sent before the box is ticked; two joins from a double tap

start: Brand-new phone, app never opened; member taps the invite link

steps.action: Tap the link; the app opens on the welcome flow
user_sees: The welcome steps (the link is kept in the background)
must_not: The link lost; the welcome flow skipped

user_sees: About a second later 'Join your gym' opens for the linked gym on its own
must_not: Join screen never opening; it opening twice

steps.action: Close the app half-way through setup, open it again and finish
user_sees: 'Join your gym' still opens after setup
must_not: The kept link forgotten after the restart

start: Member is in Gym A; taps Gym B's invite link

user_sees: 'You're in Gym A now. Switching takes you out of Gym A on this phone.'; button 'Switch to this gym'
must_not: Silent move to Gym B; the Join wording for a member who is in a gym

steps.action: Tick the box, tap 'Switch to this gym' with an open shop order
user_sees: A question about the open order before switching; 'stayed' keeps the member in Gym A
must_not: The order cancelled without asking; member left in no gym after a failed join

user_sees: Gym B's page; Gym A no longer listed
must_not: Member in both gyms; Gym A still showing the member as active after it confirms the leave

start: Invite link with a wrong or old code

user_sees: Not-found card for the code, with a way to the code box
must_not: A spinner that never ends; a join to a different gym
A blank card; the app closing

steps.action: Right code, box not ticked, tap 'Join this gym'
user_sees: A line asking to tick the box; nothing sent

start: Member already in this gym taps its invite link again

user_sees: 'You're already in <gym>. Nothing to do.' and 'Open your gym'
must_not: A second member row for the same phone; the join form shown again

user_sees: The Gym tab of that gym

start: Gym's server has the trainer view on; member joins from the link

user_sees: 'Your workouts stay on this phone.' then 'Your gym sees how many workouts you log and the weight you lift…' and 'Your gym and your trainer see your workouts, so they can help you progress.'
must_not: Two lines that say opposite things about who sees the workouts

user_sees: Trainer sharing switched on (Settings, Your gym, What my gym can see)
must_not: Sharing switched on without the member having read that it would be; body weight, photos or notes shared

steps.action: Desk staff open the member in the panel
user_sees: The name the member typed, and only what the switches allow
must_not: The member's phone number, body weight or photos
